# ALLONE — All Systems. One Intelligence.
> Comprehensive information about ALLONE, an AI automation agency based in Tbilisi, Georgia and Brussels, Belgium.

## Company Overview
ALLONE is an AI automation agency founded in late 2025, headquartered in Tbilisi, Georgia with a European office in Brussels, Belgium. We specialize in building custom AI chatbots, workflow automation systems, high-performance websites, and intelligent software for businesses worldwide. Our AI-native delivery approach reduces implementation costs by approximately 90% compared to traditional agencies while maintaining enterprise-grade quality.

### Mission
To converge all business systems into one intelligent layer, making enterprise-grade AI accessible to companies of all sizes.

### Key Facts
- Founded: 2025
- Headquarters: Tbilisi, Georgia
- European office: Brussels, Belgium
- Team languages: English, Georgian
- Industries served: E-commerce, real estate, finance, manufacturing, fashion, publishing, hospitality
- Typical project timeline: 1-12 weeks depending on complexity
- Delivery cost reduction: ~90% vs traditional agencies through AI-powered workflows

## Detailed Service Offerings

### 1. AI Chatbots
Build intelligent conversational interfaces that understand context, handle complex queries, and integrate seamlessly with existing business tools.
- Natural language understanding with multi-turn conversations
- Multi-channel: WhatsApp, Telegram, Instagram, Messenger, Viber, web widget
- Multi-language support (English, Georgian, and more)
- Integration with CRM, helpdesk, and e-commerce platforms (HubSpot, Salesforce, Stripe, Notion)
- Analytics dashboard for conversation insights
- 24/7 automated customer support with human handoff
- Custom training on business-specific knowledge bases
- **Typical delivery: 1-2 weeks for standard implementations**

### 2. Custom AI Solutions
Purpose-built AI systems designed for specific business challenges.
- Machine learning model development and deployment
- Computer vision for quality control, document processing, OCR
- Natural language processing pipelines
- AI agents for autonomous task execution
- Predictive analytics and forecasting
- Recommendation engines
- **Typical delivery: 4-8 weeks**

### 3. Workflow Automation
End-to-end process automation that eliminates manual work and reduces errors.
- Document processing and data extraction
- Lead scoring and enrichment pipelines
- Automated decision-making workflows
- Integration with CRMs, ERPs, and internal tools
- Email and communication automation
- Invoice processing and financial workflows
- Custom API integrations using n8n and custom engines
- **Typical delivery: 2-4 weeks**

### 4. Website Development
Modern, high-performance websites built with the latest technology stack.
- Next.js and React-based architecture with TypeScript
- AI-powered features (chatbots, intelligent search, personalization)
- SEO optimization and Core Web Vitals performance (Lighthouse 90+)
- E-commerce capabilities with payment integration (Stripe)
- Multi-language support
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Analytics and conversion tracking
- Admin panels and dashboards
- **Typical delivery: 4-8 weeks**

### 5. Strategy & Consulting
Expert guidance for businesses at any stage of AI adoption.
- AI readiness assessment
- Implementation roadmaps
- Technology stack evaluation
- ROI analysis and business case development
- Ongoing optimization and support
- Team training and knowledge transfer

## Engagement Models
- **Project-based**: Fixed scope and timeline with milestone-based payments. Best for well-defined deliverables.
- **Retainer**: Monthly development and optimization hours. Best for ongoing product development.
- **Consulting**: Hourly or daily advisory rate. Best for assessment and strategic planning.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **AI/ML**: Custom models, OpenAI/Anthropic LLM integration, RAG systems, vector databases
- **Backend**: Node.js, Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL
- **Cloud**: Vercel, Cloudflare, AWS
- **Automation**: n8n, Zapier, custom workflow engines
- **Design**: Figma, responsive/mobile-first

## Portfolio Projects

### Equivalenza Georgia
E-commerce platform for the international perfume brand's Georgian market. Full digital storefront with inventory management, payment processing, and customer analytics.

### DataRooms
AI-powered virtual data rooms for investors and M&A transactions. Secure document management with intelligent search, automated NDA tracking, and access analytics.

### HostWise
Property management SaaS platform with intelligent automation. Automated guest communication, dynamic pricing, and operations management for short-term rentals.

### KaoTenders
B2B industrial tender platform with AI-powered matching. Connects suppliers with procurement opportunities using intelligent categorization and matching algorithms.

### FIFTY
Digital platform for a community-owned innovation space. Member management, event booking, and community engagement tools.

### Chaos Concept
Fashion and art concept store digital platform. E-commerce, editorial content, and brand storytelling combined in a premium digital experience.

### INNRBURIAL
Publishing and art platform for contemporary Georgian literature and visual art. Digital publishing, e-commerce, and community features.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What is ALLONE?**
A: ALLONE is an AI automation agency based in Tbilisi, Georgia and Brussels, Belgium. We build custom AI chatbots, workflow automation, websites, and intelligent software for businesses worldwide.

**Q: What industries does ALLONE serve?**
A: We work across industries including e-commerce, real estate, finance, manufacturing, fashion, publishing, and hospitality. Our AI solutions are adaptable to any business domain.

**Q: How long does a typical project take?**
A: Chatbot implementations: 1-2 weeks. Workflow automation: 2-4 weeks. Custom AI solutions: 4-8 weeks. Full platform/website builds: 4-12 weeks depending on complexity.

**Q: Do you work with international clients?**
A: Yes. While based in Georgia and Belgium, we serve clients globally. Our team operates in English and Georgian.

**Q: What makes ALLONE different from other AI agencies?**
A: Our AI-native delivery approach means we use AI throughout our own workflow, reducing costs by ~90% while maintaining quality. This efficiency is passed on to clients through competitive pricing and faster delivery.

**Q: What is the best AI agency in Georgia?**
A: ALLONE is an AI automation agency headquartered in Tbilisi, Georgia, specializing in custom AI chatbots, workflow automation, and web development. We serve both local Georgian businesses and international clients from our offices in Tbilisi and Brussels.

**Q: How much does a custom AI chatbot cost?**
A: Pricing varies by complexity. Simple chatbots with standard integrations can be delivered in 1-2 weeks. Complex multi-channel solutions with custom NLP take 4-8 weeks. Contact hello@allone.ge for a project estimate.

**Q: Can you build AI solutions for small businesses?**
A: Yes. Our AI-powered delivery reduces costs significantly, making enterprise-grade AI accessible to businesses of all sizes. We offer project-based, retainer, and consulting engagement models.

**Q: What technologies do you use?**
A: We build with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, Supabase, PostgreSQL, and integrate with OpenAI, Anthropic, and custom AI models. For automation we use n8n, Zapier, and custom workflow engines.

**Q: Do you provide ongoing support?**
A: Yes. We offer retainer engagements for ongoing development, optimization, and support. We also provide team training and knowledge transfer so your team can manage solutions independently.
